mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The midpoint classification and endpoint replacement preserve regression bisection if the feature has one persistent transition in the applicable ordered correspondence. That explicitly unresolved assumption makes discarding half the interval valid; sparse tests cannot establish it. The procedure appropriately retains uncertainty and permits unresolved boundaries.

warrant_validity.rationale: Under the single-transition condition, elimination supports the stated reference boundary. Transferring that boundary to writing chronology depends on the mapping's specified but unestablished relationship: independently supported contemporaneous, exclusive feature use in comparable correspondence, anchored by reference dates that constrain writing dates. That relationship would justify the cross-group ordering and one-sided date bounds. Feature classifications alone do not establish it. The mapping appropriately withholds established bundle dates when this support is absent.

target_fidelity.rationale: The proposed cross-group ordering and one-sided calendar bounds directly contribute to the requested relative and absolute chronology. The mapping preserves uncertainty, leaves within-group order unresolved, and does not claim that letters fall within the transition interval. No separate target bridge is missing.

conditions.condition: Reference correspondence must be located and made available for the proposed inspections.
conditions.rationale: The packet does not establish the availability of reference material. Obtaining material enables inspection; its chronological and evidential qualifications remain separate substantive matters.

conditions.condition: The feature underwent one persistent transition in the applicable correspondence.
conditions.rationale: Persistence makes each midpoint classification exclude the corresponding portion of the ordered history. Without it, discarded portions can contain additional transitions or earlier positive references.

conditions.condition: Independent evidence supports contemporaneous, exclusive feature use across comparable reference and bundle correspondence, with reference dates constraining writing dates at the recorded precision.
conditions.rationale: This specified relationship connects visible feature states to writing chronology. It would support negative-before-positive ordering and the stated endpoint-derived bounds; reused stationery, parallel use, inapplicable contexts, or dates unrelated to writing would undermine that connection.

preconditions.condition: Reference correspondence must be located and made available for the proposed inspections.
preconditions.how_to_establish: Locate reference correspondence and obtain access sufficient to inspect its features and dating evidence.
preconditions.why_execution_only: Availability enables the proposed operations but does not establish persistence, chronological comparability, or the feature-to-writing-date relationship.

execution_readiness.rationale: Reference availability is explicitly unestablished. This resource prerequisite does not independently affect validity.

uncertainty: The packet supplies no reference series or independent evidence establishing persistence and exclusive contemporaneous use.
Even if the substantive conditions hold, reference gaps and date precision may leave broad or open bounds; the mapping explicitly permits those outcomes.
